workflow.label: Demo — Intent-to-workflow acceptance
workflow.description: A catalog-grounded independent test and repair workflow.

intent.description: Test the web application against approved screenshots and documents. Repair failures and retest with bounded retries. Keep the tester independent and require human acceptance before closing.
intent.requirement: Capture screenshots, documents, observable expectations and evidence locations.
Independently check the current revision using fresh evidence.
Preserve work, repair defects and return for bounded independent retesting.
Retain closing documents and obtain authorized human acceptance.
